title: Wall Mount Shower Curtain Brackets And Rod For 1-Inch Shower Rod (Pair) | Solid Brass | Prestige Regal Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with wall mount shower curtain brackets and rod supports designed to fit any 1-inch diameter shower rod, with concealed mounting for a clean finished look.

  • Made to fit: For use with any 1-inch diameter shower rod
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted from brass for durable everyday bathroom use
  • Pair included: Sold as a pair; shower rod sold separately
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Coordinated style: Designed to complement the Prestige Regal Collection and transitional bathroom hardware

Specs

  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions (each): 3 in L x 3 in W x 2.25 in H
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 1.6 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Shower curtain rod brackets and installation hardware (shower rod sold separately)
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Prestige Regal Collection Shower Curtain Rod Brackets
_previous.description: Add the finishing touch to your bathroom with these elegant shower curtain rod brackets. Made of the finest solid brass materials and will never rust or corrode. Brackets are completed with one of our wide variety of lifetime designer finishes. These items are sold as a pair and are manufactured to be used with a 1 inch diameter shower rod. Shower rod sold separately.
